payload.title: EXAMPLE — search results render for a known query
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toHaveCount(3)

Locator: getByTestId('search-result-row')
Expected: 3
Received: 0

note: EXAMPLE — not a real case, format illustration only. Zero results reads like an empty-state UI bug at first glance, but the trace's failedRequests shows the search API itself returned 503 — the UI never had data to render, not a broken empty-state path.
